checks.name: same game and target, both campaigns passed
same production budgets and exact game assets
same complete initial public packet hash
same physical commands, full animation packet hashes and primitive boundaries
same selected source prefix kinds and acquired action counts
same previously reported series projection with observation-scope normalization
same prior deferral occasions and guards with explicitly renamed native policy
partial current-control access is not required in these previous successful prefixes
same request outcomes and common caller revisions
same final public result and retained-session counters
source frozen during both campaigns and no Python agent modules

qualification: Compares commands, complete public packet hashes, source prefix kinds, acquisition counters and reported series projections. Observation session scope is normalized. Session-derived hashed program model IDs are excluded while their acquisition epochs, normalized evidence and observed/inferred operator counts remain compared. Native graph chains/revisions and shared inherited digests are excluded. Prior deferral occasions and guards are compared after the explicit policy rename; the newly added learned witness is validated by separate integration tests. No partial-access extension is required in these previous successful prefixes. Timings are excluded; this is not a speed comparison or full internal-state parity.
